name: Apex Telecom
summary: Canberra ISP brand renamed from Apex Internet ~Nov 2011; absorbed CyberOne customers Jun 2012; sold to NetSpeed Communications June 2012 (ultimate holding Velocity Internet) (APEX TELECOM PTY. LTD., ACN 152 018 436).

events.details: Renamed from Apex Internet (~Nov 2011); legal entity APEX TELECOM PTY LTD (ABN 73 152 018 436) registered 10 Jul 2011 and first traded as 'Apex Internet'. apex.net.au began 301-redirecting from 7 Aug 2011; apextelecom.com.au first captured 25 Nov 2011.
source: ABR: APEX TELECOM PTY. LTD., ABN registered 10 Jul 2011, trading name 'Apex Internet' from 10 Jul 2011
